name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Dropdown Menu: a case with a notch toward the trigger, popping in. Rows invert to ink on hover or keyboard focus; checkbox rows get a brush check, radio rows an ink diamond; destructive rows use the accent. Group labels in underlined lettering, sub-menus with a brush chevron. Put DropdownMenuLabel inside a DropdownMenuGroup: Base UI requires it (Radix does not).
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/dropdown-menu". It wraps your own components/ui/dropdown-menu, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A notched case; the row under the pointer turns to ink.
meta.usage:
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuTrigger } from "@/components/ui/manga/dropdown-menu"

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger>Chapter</DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuItem>Bookmark</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="destructive">Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>
